notes.title: Playtest for Alpha v1.6 is ready!
notes.content:
[p]We are delighted to finally share our latest progress on Hexalith, our sci-fi strategic city-builder title![/p][p]Join our discord and find the [b]v1.6 build  [u](Windows .exe only)[/u][/b] for Hexalith in the Discord [i][u]Updates[/u][/i] channel or find it on our new Itch.io page! [/p][p]We welcome and appreciate any and all feedback! If you have any questions, you can directly contact us on discord!   [/p][p][url="https://discord.gg/zKyGZC2JYr" style="button"]Find build v1.6 in Updates channel on Discord[/url]   [url="https://lazarcvetkovic.itch.io/hexalith" style="button" buttoncolor="#ff5c5c"]Find build v1.6 at the bottom of our Itch.io page[/url] [/p][p](Soon a public Steam playtest will be available as soon as it gets reviewed and approved :D)[/p][p]Additionally, you can check out the gameplay for the newest version here:[/p][previewyoutube="YB0H-AgPuZ8;full"][/previewyoutube][p]
BONUS:  The leaderboard is finally implemented into the game and we will celebrate whoever gets first place at the end of September in our Discord server![/p]
